FAQ & Help

Answers · How it works

Tokens & Points
How do I earn tokens?

You receive 20 pts when you join. Earn 40 pts per friend you refer, and 10 pts for each active subscription you maintain. Points unlock discounts: 200 pts = 10% off for 2 months · 500 pts = 1 free month.

Where do I see my token balance?

Your balance is visible in My Profile → Points tab, and in the Wallet · Tokens section of this menu. It updates automatically after each action.

How does the referral program work?

Go to My Space → Referral to get your unique link. Share it — when a friend joins Honeymoon using your link, you automatically receive 40 pts credited to your wallet.

Content & Access
What does a subscription give me?

From 9,99€/month you get access to the creator's exclusive content: private photos, videos, reels, and their private Telegram channel. Each creator has different tiers — see their profile for details.

What are PPV (Pay-Per-View) items?

Some premium photos and videos require individual tokens to unlock. The price in tokens is shown on the locked item. Your token balance is used — no separate payment needed.

How do I message a creator?

Go to My Space → Messages. All creator conversations are private and directly accessible from the creator's profile page as well. Messages are end-to-end private.

Account
Is my profile visible to other visitors?

No. Your profile is never visible to other visitors. Only creators you follow can see your name, bio, and preferences — and only the fields you choose to share in Privacy settings.

How do I delete my account?

Contact us directly via the button below. We process all deletion requests within 48h and remove all your personal data from our systems.

Need help?
Our team responds within 24h. You can also join our community on Telegram for live updates.
Contact support → Telegram community →

Explore

Choose your universe

Luna — Honey Girl

Luna is Honeymoon's first face. Natural, unfiltered, and genuinely present — she's on BongaCams daily. Her content is intimate, not performative. She doesn't play a character. She's the girl you feel like you actually know. Her universe is warm, spontaneous, and deeply personal. The kind of girl you think about after.

Zara — Original

Zara creates content that exists nowhere else. Cinematic, bold, curated with precision — every photo set and video is intentional. She's on Stripchat but her real archive lives here. Fan Club members unlock her private world: behind-the-scenes reels, exclusive photo sets, and direct chat. If you value quality over quantity, Zara is your creator.

Nova — Ambassadrice

Nova is intense, private, and selective. She streams on both BongaCams and Stripchat but her real self only appears for those who earn it. As Honeymoon's Ambassadrice, she has an exclusive channel and a direct line few ever access. She doesn't chase attention — it comes to her. If you want her, you'll know why when you find her.

Dream — Star

Dream doesn't stream on a schedule. She appears when she wants, for who deserves it. Her Fan Club is the most exclusive on Honeymoon — full archive access, custom requests, and a direct connection that feels nothing like a subscription. No tokens required. Just a commitment. She's rare, intentional, and completely unforgettable.
